exact_gap.requirement: Inject a failure after function setup but before application COMMIT; attempt runtime activation before independent cleanup verification
exact_gap.observed: Actual failed immutable deployments, rollback, inactive runtime credentials before installation and after cleanup, original-grantor finalization, intended failure diagnostics and retained failure ledger.
exact_gap.unobserved: Distinct activation gate attempt after the failed deployment connection exits and before original-grantor finalization/independent cleanup verification.

proven_source_analysis.gate_law: permit requires a closed successful installation AND separately verified original-grantor cleanup, with one-time activation.

bounded_candidate.namespace: NEW_VERSION_REQUIRED; preserve all V4 source, fixtures and actual history
bounded_candidate.change: Add a phase-qualified activation attempt after a genuine closed failed deploy, before entering finally finalization. Persist the phase, actual closed failure identity, unchanged false gate prerequisites, exact refusal code and database_password_sql_executed=false. Verify four runtime verifiers remain NULL and reject independent candidate startup using the existing bounded authentication helper. Keep evidence labels unique so the later held outcome cannot overwrite this phase.
bounded_candidate.authority_observation: At this stage independently observe the same exact three temporary original-grantor memberships and false leaf CREATE using the existing authority query; do not remove grants until finally. Keep actual operation connection absent before each observation.
bounded_candidate.failure_rule: Unexpected gate permission, active runtime verifier/login, malformed evidence, closure or persistence failure stops the attempt; finally still closes connections, runs original-grantor finalization and owned cleanup.
bounded_candidate.scope_choice: Prefer a smallest coherent versioned packet for the missing phase; author must explain whether reusing the full reviewed three-target suite or a smaller immutable failed-install packet best preserves actual proof and avoids unnecessary repetitions.
bounded_candidate.sql_changes: None to canonical SQL, both already reviewed failure variants, bootstrap, finalization, grants, RLS or worker32 ACL.
bounded_candidate.positive_activation: Never execute ALTER ROLE/PASSWORD during this failed-install phase. The actual production activation gate must reject before generating/executing that SQL.
required_regressions: Actual ordering after closed failed deploy and before finalization
Old faulty ordering or omitted phase rejected
Closed failure with install-success false and cleanup-unverified false blocks
Unexpected permit, active runtime credential and malformed observations reject
Thrown observer/persistence error preserves safe origin and still finalizes/cleans
Canonical and original failure SQL/worker ACL and prior source bytes unchanged
bounded_candidate.mock_boundaries: Every Docker/database/process boundary mocked for offline checks; actual proof only in subsequent separately reviewed fresh owned local run.

review_requirements: Separate nonauthor review of scope, actual phase evidence, unchanged security rules and test independence before committed packet pin/literal review/fresh actual.
